title: Zetwerk Q2 FY27 (Jul-Sep 2026; results filed 13 Nov 2026, its first since listing on 23 Oct 2026): revenue from operations ₹4,599 crore (+18% YoY, +12% QoQ); net loss ₹88 crore (+43% from ₹61.6 crore YoY; -88% from ₹733 crore in Q1 FY27); adjusted PBT (excl. share-based payments) ₹28 crore; manufacturing order book a record ₹14,595 crore (+67% YoY); Q2 new orders ₹4,613 crore (+44%); NSE listing ₹159.25 vs IPO price ₹151
